name: Slack MCP Server
summary: Slack's official remote MCP server at mcp.slack.com: search messages, files, users and channels, read and send messages, and manage canvases and lists.
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP at `https://mcp.slack.com/mcp` (no SSE and no Dynamic Client Registration). MCP clients must be backed by a registered Slack app with a fixed app ID; only Slack Marketplace-published or internal apps may use MCP, and workspace admins approve and manage MCP client integrations. Users authorize through Slack OAuth (user tokens). Tools are rate-limited like the equivalent Web API methods.

agent_access.notes: OAuth metadata at https://mcp.slack.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Requires a Marketplace or internal Slack app.
